lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines are visible across the torso, with closer spacing in the anterior section (30-40 pixels) and wider intervals in the posterior section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One visible Y-shaped bifurcation located on the posterior third of the torso, where two lines merge at approximately the mid-point of the vertical flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several central line segments terminate mid-flank before reaching the ventral fringe, specifically visible in the 5th and 6th lines from the shoulder.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch area, immediately superior to the hind leg joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots is visible on the mid-thigh of the posterior limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horn follows a lyrate trajectory, initiating with a posterior sweep from the skull base and curving into a vertical, slightly anterior-facing apical vector.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored terminal tips occupy approximately 12% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest extending from the neck to the rump, two distinct white spots on the lateral muzzle, and high-contrast white chevron marking between the ocular regions.
